kpis.quote: For the three months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025, we reported total revenue of $8.2 million and $5.1 million, respectively
with $4.7 million and $2.1 million being generated in our water and wastewater resource development segment
with $3.3 million and $2.9 million in our land development segment
Lot sales revenue increased to $3.0 million for the three months ended May 31, 2026 compared to $2.5 million in the same period in 2025.
Net income for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025 of $2.9 million and $8.6 million, and $2.3 million and $7.0 million, respectively
EBITDA for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025 of $4.7 million and $13.6 million, and $3.6 million and $11.3 million, respectively
Water deliveries increased for the three months ended May 31, 2026 to 631 acre-feet delivered as compared to 76 acre-feet delivered in the same period in 2025.
During the three months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025, the Company sold a total of 66 and 40 water taps, respectively

guidance.text: The company expects to substantially complete Phase 2D by the end of fiscal 2026.
guidance.quote: we expect to substantially complete Phase 2D by the end of fiscal 2026 and collect the related contractual milestone and finished-lot payments with minimal remaining development costs.

guidance.text: The company expects to complete approximately 159 lots in fiscal 2027.
guidance.quote: We have also begun construction activities in Phase 2E, where we expect to complete approximately 159 lots in fiscal 2027, paced to match builder absorption.

guidance.text: The company currently expects continued demand for oil and gas water sales for the remainder of 2026.
guidance.quote: however, our current expectation is for continued demand for oil and gas water sales for the remainder of 2026.

guidance.text: The majority of the 23 contracted additional rental homes are expected to be available for rent in calendar 2026.
guidance.quote: the majority of which we expect to be available for rent in calendar 2026.

data.summary: Quarterly revenue increased 60% to $8.2 million and net income rose 31% to $2.9 million compared with the prior-year quarter. Growth included higher water and wastewater revenue and water deliveries, alongside increased lot sales revenue.
